label_rule: conflict means the two directives cannot both govern the same project, kind-independent subject, and software version; scope/version decoys are non-conflicts

pairs.a: Always checkpoint the WAL before copying the SQLite database.
pairs.b: Never checkpoint the WAL before copying the SQLite database.

pairs.a: Always refresh the expired bearer token before retrying a 401 request.
pairs.b: Do not refresh the expired bearer token before retrying a 401 request.

pairs.a: Always reject a release artifact after a SHA-256 manifest mismatch.
pairs.b: Never reject a release artifact after a SHA-256 manifest mismatch.

pairs.a: Always stop distributed writes when lease renewal fails.
pairs.b: Continue distributed writes when lease renewal fails.

pairs.a: Keep the prior schema reader active throughout the column backfill.
pairs.b: Remove the prior schema reader before the column backfill begins.

pairs.a: Preserve the last stable sort key in a next-page cursor.
pairs.b: Never preserve the last stable sort key in a next-page cursor.

pairs.a: Always store the UTC instant with the user's IANA zone.
pairs.b: Never store the UTC instant with the user's IANA zone.

pairs.a: Always honor Retry-After on an HTTP 429 response.
pairs.b: Do not honor Retry-After on an HTTP 429 response.

pairs.a: Rebuild stored vectors after the embedding model revision changes.
pairs.b: Never rebuild stored vectors after the embedding model revision changes.

pairs.a: Propagate request cancellation to every outbound API call.
pairs.b: Do not propagate request cancellation to outbound API calls.

pairs.a: Persist the idempotency result before acknowledging queue delivery.
pairs.b: Never persist the idempotency result before acknowledging queue delivery.

pairs.a: Include the lockfile digest in the CI dependency cache key.
pairs.b: Do not include the lockfile digest in the CI dependency cache key.

pairs.a: Always use offset pagination for the immutable result archive.
pairs.b: Never use offset pagination for the immutable result archive.

pairs.a: Always accept the legacy bearer-token prefix.
pairs.b: Do not accept the legacy bearer-token prefix.

pairs.a: Always rebuild the old lexical index after startup.
pairs.b: Never rebuild the old lexical index after startup.

pairs.a: Always retry a 429 without jitter when Retry-After is present.
pairs.b: Do not retry a 429 without jitter when Retry-After is present.

pairs.a: Always keep the prior reader during backfill.
pairs.b: Never keep the prior reader during backfill.

pairs.a: Always renew the lease before expiry.
pairs.b: Do not renew the lease before expiry.

pairs.a: Always persist queue results before ack.
pairs.b: Never persist queue results before ack.

pairs.a: Always reject a mismatched release digest.
pairs.b: Never reject a mismatched release digest.

pairs.a: Always record the active model revision with each vector.
pairs.b: Always record the active model revision with each vector before indexing.

pairs.a: Never ship an artifact with a mismatched digest.
pairs.b: Do not ship an artifact with a mismatched digest.

pairs.a: Always use the saved IANA zone for calendar display.
pairs.b: Never reuse an expired bearer token on a protected request.

pairs.a: Always fence stale distributed lease holders.
pairs.b: Never ignore a signed manifest digest mismatch.
